jobs.description:
Do you want to work full-time and have certainty in your job? Are you looking for an active workplace with
great colleagues? Tadaaa! 🎉 You found it. Earn a nice hourly wage of €14.99 and grab those evening
surcharges up to 40%. Read on quickly and apply directly as a Warehouse worker at PostNL in
Nieuwegein! 🚀

What we offer
- A great salary of €14,99 gross per hour
- A varied workplace
- Nice evening allowances up to 40% for your shifts
- Double salary on Sundays!
- A full-time job with of 35 hours a week!
- A chance to get a permanent contract at PostNL!

Who you are
You are the indispensable link in our team! To start successfully as a Warehouse worker, you meet the
following requirements:

- You master the English or Dutch language well 🗣️;
- You are available to work full-time in the evening shifts;
- You have your own transport to travel to Nieuwegein independently 🚗;
- You have flexible availability between 17:30 and 02:45;
- You are available from Monday to Friday (Sunday optional) 📆.

What will you do
As a Warehouse worker, you ensure that all important packages are shipped on time 📦! You collect the
orders with extreme precision and pack them tightly. By doing this, you make thousands of customers
super happy every day! What is on your to-do list?

- You unload trucks and scan the incoming packages super fast 🚚;
- You sort the packages accurately for the right delivery routes;
- You build the roll containers neatly and safely for transport. ✨

Where will you work
You will work at PostNL in Nieuwegein, a gigantic and famous logistics player! 🌎  Safety and a great
working environment are absolutely number one here. You will be trained extremely well by
experienced team leaders, so you can work independently in no time 💪. There is plenty of room to grow
into an assistant team leader role. Great job 🙌!

Job application
Ready, set, go! Apply directly via the button! I will contact you within one working day to discuss all
possibilities. See you soon

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you carry out repairs and maintenance work on aircraft components. You work precisely, following fixed specifications and using professional tools. 

Good to know: around 20-30% of your work is administrative. This includes reading and working with technical drawings and manuals, in English. You'll switch between these two sides of the trade throughout the day: working with your hands, and carefully reading documentation.

- MBO+ level of thinking and working: good with your hands, with an eye for detail and patience for the administrative side
- Open to recently graduated with internship experience
- You have an affinity for sheet metal work or metalworking (e.g. as an automotive body repair technician)
- You can read and understand English well (technical drawings and manuals are in English)
- You don't have a 9 to 5 mentality and are open to work in the evening or weekends if needed (after 8 months of employment)

Are you technically and practically minded and do you enjoy working with your hands on large, impressive projects? Do you like tinkering, getting things done and working together in a team? Then this full-time position as Aviation Assembly Technician is exactly what you are looking for. You will receive a direct contract with the employer, a good salary and plenty of opportunities to further develop yourself within technology and aviation. Read on!

Manpower is looking for an assembly mechanic for a company in Enschede.

As an aviation assembly technician, you will work together with colleagues on the disassembly, assembly and maintenance of aviation components. Your work is varied and hands-on in nature.

Your tasks will include:

    - Disassembling and assembling technical components according to fixed guidelines
    
- Inspecting, securing and processing components
    
- Working together with experienced colleagues and learning new skills
    
- Working in the workshop and on location
    
- Working according to safety and quality regulations

What's in it for you

    - Gross monthly salary between €3,200 and €3,700
    
- Full-time position (40 hours per week)
    
- Direct contract with the employer
    
- 25 vacation days
    
- Bonus scheme: an extra month’s salary paid at the end of the year
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
    
- Room for personal development and career growth opportunities
    
- Working in an enthusiastic team with a passion for technology and aviation

    - Technical insight and at least MBO-level working and thinking ability
    
- Experience as a mechanic or technician is a plus (for example in aviation or automotive engineering)
    
- Practical, solution-oriented and a true team player
    
- Good command of the English language
    
- No problem with working outdoors

Does this sound like your next step in technology? Don’t wait any longer and apply directly. We will contact you soon to discuss the possibilities with you!

Ready to rock in the dayshift with a salary up to €15.72 per hour?😍 YES, it's possible! At Stegeman in Wijhe, you can start as a Production Employee. What's more? you'll be trained to become an Operator within just 2 months! Talk about a fast track to success! 🚀 For this function you will need your own housing in the Netherlands. Unfortunately we do not offer housing with this job. Read on and check out the full vacancy!

What we offer
- Up to €15.72 per hour, NICE!
- Guaranteed 32 hours? Of course!
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer!
- Full-time in the dayshift!
- Grow into an Operator position! 📈
- Work alongside the absolute BEST colleagues!

Who you are
You love to keep busy and work at a good pace. Also, as a Production Employee, we require the following from you:

- That you are able to speak Dutch or English for safety reasons within the factory
- That you are able to work in a dayshift
- that you are able to get to Wijhe by either your own transport or public transport
- You must be at least 1.65cm tall for safety reasons within the factory

What will you do
Grab your work shoes! 👟 At Stegeman, this is your chance to show your best side! How? By getting straight to work! 💪
As a Production Employee, you'll be assigned to the Processing department. This is where you prepare the meat before it gets sliced. Your exact task? You'll ensure the meat pieces come together and that the correct blend of spices is added. Look at that—it already looks and smells delicious! In addition, setting up the machines is also part of your job. Hello, varied workdays! 👋 Besides the manual tasks, the meat pieces need to be transported from one production hall to another. Hop onto that EPT and go! 🤩 WOW, not so fast, we can barely keep up with you!
You'll work Monday through Friday during the day. This means your evenings and weekends are completely FREE! Enjoy that well-deserved time off!

Where will you work
As a Production Employee, you'll be working at Stegeman i

About the job

Are you precise, motivated, and do you enjoy working in a clean and well-organized environment? As a Cleanroom Operator, you will make sure that components are carefully cleaned, inspected, and packaged for customers in the high-tech industry.This is a varied position where accuracy, quality, and teamwork are key.

What will you do?

In this role, you will work in a cleanroom environment where precision and quality are essential. You will work with customers from the high-tech, medical, automotive, and aerospace industries — sectors where there is no room for error and where your work directly contributes to the final product.As a Cleanroom Operator, you will play an important role in cleaning, inspecting, and packaging components. You will work according to clear protocols and detailed work instructions.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning components using modern machines or manually
- (Dis)assembling components based on technical drawings
- Performing detailed quality inspections, including inspections using UV lamps
Packaging components in the cleanroom to ensure they arrive at the customer in perfect condition

You will work in a modern, safe, and well-organized environment where teamwork and quality are highly valued.

What are we looking for?

- MBO-level education or equivalent working and thinking level
- Experience in a cleanroom or assembly environment is a plus, but not required — we are happy to train you
- Good command of English; Dutch is a plus
- You work accurately and independently and have a flexible attitude
- You are available to work in shifts: 06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00
- You don't meet all the requirements but think this position could be a good fit for you? We would still love to hear from you!

Hey there! 👋 Do you like to work with a close international team and are you a good organizer?  Are you a big fan of computers and other IT related products? Then we have the perfect job for you: Warehouse Employee! You will help keep big computer systems working well. It's a steady job and a place where being careful is important. ✨ Ready to start? Read more! 👇

What we offer
- Salary: € 14,99 per hour!
- Temporary with a view to the long term
- Work in a small but fun team
- Working hours: 08:00 - 17:00
- Every 3 weeks you'll work in the weekend
- Bonus of 50% on Saturday and 100% on Sunday!

Who you are
You are a careful person who likes to work hard! 💪 You follow directions well, you can work by yourself, and you are a good team player. You should be able to lift up to 25 kg. Safety is important to you! 🛡️

- You speak the English language;
- VOG: you want to apply for a Certificate of Conduct (reimbursed);

What will you do
You will do many different tasks in the warehouse. 🛠️ For example:

- Set up and move parts: Put new parts in and move old parts out.
- Help with shipping: Receive computer parts and send them out.
- Do general warehouse jobs: This means picking, packing, scanning, and counting.
- Follow rules carefully: Make sure everything is done correctly in the data center. 💡

Where will you work
You will work at a remote location in Middenmeer. The warehouse is a place where many computers are. 🏢 It can be a bit noisy and warm, but you will be part of a team that works well together.

- Bonus: 50% on Saturday and 100% on Sunday
- Travel allowance: € 0,23 per kilometer

Are you looking to work as an operator in Breda within a clean, structured pharmaceutical production environment? Do you want to work with clear instructions and strict quality standards, producing goods that reach patients worldwide? Are you seeking a job that offers a good salary, training opportunities, and a team where precision is the norm? As an operator, you will perform manual production and packaging tasks, monitor quality, and work in a 3-shift or 5-shift schedule. You can earn up to €3,650 gross per month and further develop your skills in a professional work environment.

Functieomschrijving:
As an operator, you work on manual production and packaging lines within a pharmaceutical environment. You follow clear work instructions, inspect the product, and ensure that every step is carried out neatly and in compliance with regulations. Your duties generally include the following:
• Performing manual production and packaging tasks.
• Monitoring quality during the production process.
• Accurately completing batch records, logbooks, and other GMP documentation.
• Identifying and reporting deviations.
• Supporting discussions between Quality and Production to resolve issues.
• Carrying out start-up, shutdown, and cleaning activities.
• Working safely, accurately, and according to established procedures.
• Maintaining a clean, organized, and controlled workspace.

Functievereisten:
This role is a great fit for someone who takes pride in working neatly and feels comfortable in an environment with clear rules. You don't need to know everything upfront, but accuracy, reliability, and a commitment to quality are essential. Does this sound like you?
• Experience in a production environment.
• Ability to work accurately according to work instructions and procedures.
• An eye for quality, safety, and hygiene.
• Comfortable performing manual production or packaging tasks.
• Reliable work ethic and a collaborative attitude.
• Good command of the English language.

In this role, you are the guardian of quality for highly specialized processes within an international high-tech company. The company develops, repairs, and inspects critical components for the aerospace, energy, and defense industries. Together with your team, you work every day to achieve the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your attention to detail and expertise in handling valuable and delicate components make you an essential partner for our customers. In addition, you participate in 5S projects aimed at making work processes safer and more efficient.

You will work in a rotating two-shift schedule: one week in the day shift (five days) and the next week in the evening shift (four days).

- Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) inspections to ensure quality and detect discontinuities or defects using methods such as eddy current testing and ultrasonic testing
- Experience with: Visual inspections, dimensional inspections, receiving inspections and reading and interpreting technical drawings
- Knowledge of and experience with measuring instruments such as calipers and micrometers
- Good command of the English language

As a warehouse production worker, you are responsible for sorting, processing, and preparing IT materials for further processing or recycling. This full-time position consists of 40 hours per week, monday through friday. Employment starts with a 7-month temporary contract through Luba, with the possibility of a permanent contract with the company after 750 worked hours.

You start your workday with a short team meeting where tasks are assigned. After that, you begin working in the warehouse: you sort incoming goods, perform quality checks, and ensure that everything is stored in the correct location. In addition, you support the production process and help ensure that daily logistics operations run smoothly. You work closely with colleagues and maintain a clean and safe working environment.

Are you precise, enjoy working as part of a team, and want to contribute to a more sustainable future? Apply now as a warehouse production worker and make a difference in this dynamic and stable work environment!

- Experience with production or warehouse work
- Team-oriented and communicative
- Accurate and responsible work attitude
- Basic knowledge of the English language

As a Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you play a key role in ensuring a smooth and efficient logistics process. You will join a supportive and collaborative team where communication, flexibility, and teamwork are highly valued.

In this all-round position, you will work across multiple warehouse departments and, when required, at different Samsung SDS locations in Tilburg.  
Your responsibilities may include physically active tasks such as order picking, packing, and preparing shipments, as well as administrative duties like inspecting incoming goods, managing inventory, and processing data in warehouse management systems. This variety allows you to develop a broad range of skills while keeping your work challenging and engaging.

Flexibility is an important part of the role. You will primarily work in a two-shift schedule (morning and evening shifts), but during peak periods you may also be required to work night shifts and occasional Saturdays. 

Working hours range from 20 to 37.5 hours per week, offering flexibility while supporting the operational needs of the business.

Ready to become part of a global organization and contribute to efficient warehouse operations? We'd love to hear from you!

You enjoy staying active and thrive in an international working environment. You are reliable, flexible, and enjoy working as part of a team. You're comfortable adapting to different tasks, departments, and warehouse locations.

Requirements:

- You have your own transportation to travel to Tilburg.
- You have a good command of the English language.
- You are available to work full-time.
- You are physically fit and able to perform warehouse activities.
- You are flexible and willing to work in a three-shift schedule, including evening shifts, night shifts when required, and occasional Saturdays.
- You are a team player with a proactive attitude.
- You are willing to work across multiple departments and warehouse locations.

Our client is the market leader in the audiovisual industry.

Responsibilities/Tasks  

The AV Programmer will be responsible for assisting customers with the installation and operation of a wide range of A/V control products.

Technical Support & Control Applications
.Provide remote and potentially on-site support for AV control systems, assisting with configuration, and troubleshooting.
.Diagnose issues related to control software, AV hardware communication (RS232, TCP/IP), and third-party device integration.
.Guide customers through system setup and resolve anomalies in software or hardware operation.
.Provide advanced training for customers-programmers, online or in internal or external facilities, on control solutions.

Sales & Feedback
.Provide feedback to the Control Manager when a case needs escalation.
.Inform product improvement needs to the Product & Development team based on field experience and tender requirements.
.Maintain awareness of certifications and specifications relevant to AV control systems.
.Report technical issues using internal tools.

 
Requirements    

A strong background in other control systems - such as AMX, Crestron, or QSC - is essential, along with solid experience in Python programming (or similar). The ideal candidate will demonstrate a deep understanding of integrated A/V environments and be capable of adapting to diverse technical challenges. We are looking for someone based in the BENELUX or DACH area that speaks fluent English.
 
Technical Expertise
.Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows OS (servers, registry, DLLs), SQL databases.
.Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Ethernet, IP addressing, NAT, routers).
.Proficiency in Python 3 programming and Visual Studio Code knowledge.
.Familiarity with communication protocols (RS232/RS422, SSH, web sockets).
.Experience with AV system integration and control platforms (Extron, AMX, Crestron).
 
Communication & Reporting
.Fluent in English, with good verbal and written communication skills.
.Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
.Methodical troubleshooting skills and attention to detail.
.Regular reporting on status using internal tools.

Education & Experience
.Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
.Proven experience in AV technical support, system design, and field commissioning of AV control systems.

What's in it for you: 

.13th month salary 
.Competitive salary
.26 vacation days
.Health insurance contribution 
.Travel reimbursement
.Hybrid setup - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
.Pension Contribution 
.Extensive training programs 
.Working within a professional team

We are looking for a Technical services Manager within an International technical company in the Utrecht area. 

Responsibilities/Tasks  

This is an engineering management position within our client's Sales Department. The Technical Services Manager is responsible for all applications support, designs support and repair support for resellers in Europe. This position reports to the Technical Services Director. The Technical Services Manager will have the following responsibilities:

.Manage and coach all Applications Engineers in her/ his team making sure the best technical service is provided for customers. 
.Manage all goals and objectives pertaining to the technical sales team. 
.Manage on a project basis, escalated technical issues, commissioning, or design projects. 

Pre-sales
.Manage the Applications Engineers support to Sales Management and Resellers in the pre-sales process: 
-Ensuring the right support is provided to Sales Managers and Technical Sales/ Account Managers with large designs, tenders and quotes. 
-Ensure the Applications Engineers are proactively following up on smaller designs, tenders and advise/ promote on products. 
-Monitor the follow up on projects are done adequately 

After-sales
.Manage the Applications Engineers support to resellers. 
-Ensuring the right support is provided while trouble shooting 
-Ensuring the right procedures are followed by the application engineers within the RMA process 
-Evaluate the success rate of the Applications Engineers technical support. 
-Evaluate the success rate of the Applications Engineers provided project support. 
-Monitor and provide all required to resolve issues causing customers to be unhappy with products or services. 
-Manage on-site commissioning support for projects that require this. 

Training 
·Manage the training requirements of the Applications Engineers individually or as a group. 
-Train or resource training Applications Engineers making sure they can provide technical design and support efficiently on current products and technologies. 
-Train or resource training Applications Engineers making sure they can provide technical design and support efficiently on newly released products and technologies. 
-Train and/ or retrain Applications Engineer(s) based on the evaluation of the technical and design support provided. 

Product development 
Inform product development through the standard processes about required products or products improvements needed for complying with tenders or enhance system designs.

Personal responsibilities 
·She/ he should be able to perform all the functions of an Applications Engineer, at the highest level, as described in the Applications Engineer job description.
·She/ he needs to make all efforts to stay up to date with new technologies 

Requirements
·Strong and practical A/V experience in the field either with an A/V manufacturer or at a reseller in a technical position that involves managing, system design, programming and commissioning of AV, AV control and AV over IP systems. 
·Experience working in an international environment and being able to travel. 
·Ability to manage stressful environments and situations and to guide processes towards solution. 
·Strong attention to details, highly organized, computer literate. 
·Strong experience with managing technical staff in Av integration. 
·Well-developed training skills and experience to conduct technical training. 
·Excellent communication skills (verbal and in writing) in English. 
·Ability to work well in a fast-paced professional office environment. 
·The ability to operate self-directed and proactively on given task. 

What you get (or can get):
.13th month salary 
.Health insurance contribution 
.Pension Contribution 
.Extensive training programs 
.Working within a professional team
